title: Restore CKC fuzzy, vector, combination search and rich tags
operator_request: Original CKC had fuzzy search, vector search, combination search, rich tags, and a notes system for images and tags.

lifecycle.claim_recovery_reason: Status recovery: legacy RFV contract lacked lifecycle.claimed_by; Kernel Builder inspected current MT state and accepts implementer-side handoff responsibility without claiming validator PASS/FAIL.

state_recovery.recovery_rule: Inspect existing search/vector/tag infrastructure before adding new search stacks.

scope.summary: Make CKC searchable across characters, media, albums, notes, and tags with fuzzy/vector/combined modes.
base_scope: Audit existing Handshake search, vector, and tag primitives.
Implement CKC fuzzy search over character/media/tag fields.
Implement or wire vector search using existing Handshake vector/index systems.
Implement combination search that can intersect text, vector, tags, and character/media constraints.
Expose rich tags and tag notes without collapsing them into character notes.
Update internal UserManual with search modes and expected inputs/outputs.
acceptance_criteria: CKC exposes fuzzy, vector, and combined search modes.
Search results can cite stable CKC character/media/tag refs.
Rich tags and tag notes round-trip.
Argus can inspect and steer the search controls.
verification: Backend tests for fuzzy/vector/combined search behavior.
Native UI tests for search controls and result rows.

commands_run.evidence: 1 passed; proves CKC fuzzy/vector/combined search API, stable refs, tag-note round-trip, invalid-scope no-orphan-tag behavior, and pgvector projection path.
7 passed; proves Atelier tabs and Argus-addressable CKC search/tag-note controls.
1 passed; proves internal manual documents CKC search/tag-note controls and vector status tokens.
1 passed; proves backend-loaded tag notes are filtered by matching result refs before UI display.

results.summary: MT-011 implementation restored CKC fuzzy/vector/combined search, native pgvector CKC projections, rich tag notes, frontend search controls, Argus steerability, and internal manual coverage.

Post-implementation frontend/manual/Argus review passed. Backend storage/API review failed once on vector schema invariant and untracked migration, then passed after explicit public-extension invariant checks and scoped staging.

handoff.summary: Product commit 91a12ce0 pushed to origin/feat/WP-CKC-posekit-overhaul. Validator should inspect the CKC search API, pgvector migration invariant, frontend Argus controls, and manual coverage.
